subject: general
question: Five people, A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a row, facing north. D sits at the extreme left end of the line. E sits third to the right of A. B sits to the immediate right of A. How many people sit(s) between D and E?
solution:
**Given: **Five people, A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a row, facing north.

1. D sits at the extreme left end of the line.

2. E sits third to the right of A.

3. B sits to the immediate right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5429409d368e452b9f4e481da4273841ce24c897350fdd9e172dcc04c455c266.png] 

C, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3dd666aabd926b5cbd686aaa95d69604cf8196737cb8af24ccc7ff51c37acdb6.png] 

Thus, 3 people sits between D and E.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
